```{r}
mimics_metabs    <- read.csv("~/Documents/gutmicrobiome_pharmacology/mimics_metabs.csv")
opposites_metabs <- read.csv("~/Documents/gutmicrobiome_pharmacology/opposites_metabs.csv")

overlap_opposites <- opposites_metabs %>%
  filter(category == "Common to all three analyses") %>%
  pull(y) %>%
  unique() %>%
  na.omit()

# shared function
format_metab_name <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), NA,
    paste0(sub("_.*", "", x), " (", sub("^[^_]*_", "", x), ")")
  )
}

# clean pathway names function
clean_pathway_names <- function(mat) {
  rownames(mat) <- gsub(" - Homo sapiens \\(human\\)", "", rownames(mat))
  mat
}
```

# filtering top mimics and opposites from raw spearman gene-metab

```{r}
overlap_mimics <- mimics_metabs %>%
  filter(category == "Common to all three analyses") %>%
  pull(y) %>%
  unique() %>%
  na.omit()

overlap_opposites <- opposites_metabs %>%
  filter(category == "Common to all three analyses") %>%
  pull(y) %>%
  unique() %>%
  na.omit()

top_mimics <- rr_sig %>%
  filter(y %in% overlap_mimics) %>%
  dplyr::select(y, rho, q_x, q_y, FDR_drug_sig, FDR_metab_sig) %>%
  mutate(Metabolite = format_metab_name(y)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Metabolite, rho, q_x, q_y, FDR_drug_sig, FDR_metab_sig) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    "Unadjusted rho"          = rho,
    "FDR (drug)"              = q_x,
    "FDR (metabolite)"        = q_y,
    "Drug significance"       = FDR_drug_sig,
    "Metabolite significance" = FDR_metab_sig
  )

top_opposites <- rr_sig %>%
  filter(y %in% overlap_opposites) %>%
  dplyr::select(y, rho, q_x, q_y, FDR_drug_sig, FDR_metab_sig) %>%
  mutate(Metabolite = format_metab_name(y)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Metabolite, rho, q_x, q_y, FDR_drug_sig, FDR_metab_sig) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    "Unadjusted rho"          = rho,
    "FDR (drug)"              = q_x,
    "FDR (metabolite)"        = q_y,
    "Drug significance"       = FDR_drug_sig,
    "Metabolite significance" = FDR_metab_sig
  )
```

# function over multiple metabolites

```{r}
# fgsea function - WITH formatted metabolite names
run_fgsea_for_metabolite <- function(met_name, gmr_sig, reg_z, pathways) {
  df <- gmr_sig %>%
    filter(y == met_name) %>%
    left_join(reg_z, by = "x") %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    mutate(combined_score = sign(rho1) * -log10(pval))
  ranks <- setNames(df$combined_score, df$x) %>% sort(decreasing = TRUE)
  fg <- fgsea(pathways = pathways, stats = ranks, minSize = 15, maxSize = 500, nPermSimple = 10000)
  if (nrow(fg) == 0) return(NULL)
  as_tibble(fg) %>%
    mutate(metabolite = format_metab_name(met_name))  # formatted name here
}
```

# run fgsea

```{r}
fgsea_mimics <- map_dfr(overlap_mimics, run_fgsea_for_metabolite, gmr_sig, reg_z, kegg_gene_sets)
fgsea_opposites <- map_dfr(overlap_opposites, run_fgsea_for_metabolite, gmr_sig, reg_z, kegg_gene_sets)

write_csv(fgsea_opposites, "~/Documents/gutmicrobiome_pharmacology/fgsea_top_opposites_regorafenib_metabolites.csv")
```

# get KEGG pathway IDs

```{r}
kegg_pathway_ids <- keggList("pathway", "hsa")
```

# get gene sets

```{r}
kegg_gene_sets <- lapply(seq_along(kegg_pathway_ids), function(i) {
  pid <- names(kegg_pathway_ids)[i]
  tryCatch({
    result <- keggGet(pid)[[1]]
    genes <- result$GENE
    if (is.null(genes)) return(NULL)
    # odd indices are entrez IDs, even are descriptions
    entrez_ids <- genes[seq(1, length(genes), by = 2)]
    # convert entrez to gene symbols to match your x column in gmr_sig
    symbols <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, 
                      keys = entrez_ids, 
                      column = "SYMBOL", 
                      keytype = "ENTREZID",
                      multiVals = "first")
    symbols <- symbols[!is.na(symbols)]
    if (length(symbols) == 0) return(NULL)
    unname(symbols)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
})
names(kegg_gene_sets) <- kegg_pathway_ids
kegg_gene_sets <- Filter(Negate(is.null), kegg_gene_sets)
```

```{r}
saveRDS(kegg_gene_sets, "~/Documents/gutmicrobiome_pharmacology/kegg_gene_sets.rds")
```

```{r}
# function over multiple metabolites
run_fgsea_for_metabolite <- function(met_name, gmr_sig, reg_z, pathways) {
  df <- gmr_sig %>%
    filter(y == met_name) %>%
    left_join(reg_z, by = "x") %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    mutate(combined_score = sign(rho1) * -log10(pval))
  ranks <- setNames(df$combined_score, df$x) %>% sort(decreasing = TRUE)
  fg <- fgsea(pathways = pathways, stats = ranks, minSize = 15, maxSize = 500, nPermSimple = 10000)
  if (nrow(fg) == 0) return(NULL)
  as_tibble(fg) %>%
    mutate(metabolite = met_name,
           metabolite = format_metab_name(met_name))  # format name here
}

# run fgsea
fgsea_mimics <- map_dfr(overlap_mimics, run_fgsea_for_metabolite, gmr_sig, reg_z, kegg_gene_sets)
fgsea_opposites <- map_dfr(overlap_opposites, run_fgsea_for_metabolite, gmr_sig, reg_z, kegg_gene_sets)
```

# update for poster

```{r}
## ============================================================================
## Figure 4 (revised) — ONE curated heatmap: Mimics | Opposites
##   rows    = curated KEGG pathways (grouped by theme)
##   columns = metabolites, split into  Mimics | Opposites
##   colour  = NES   (green = activated / positive, navy = suppressed / negative)
##
## Drop this in AFTER you have built `fgsea_mimics` and `fgsea_opposites`
## (each with columns: pathway, NES, padj, metabolite).
##
## The three knobs you'll actually tune are flagged  ### TUNE ###
## ============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(ComplexHeatmap)   # BiocManager::install("ComplexHeatmap") if needed
library(circlize)         # colorRamp2()  (installs with ComplexHeatmap)
## ComplexHeatmap pulls in S4Vectors/IRanges, which mask several dplyr/base verbs
## (slice, filter, select, intersect, union, ...). Pin the ones we use so the
## script doesn't dispatch to the wrong method regardless of load order.
library(conflicted)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::slice, dplyr::filter, dplyr::select, dplyr::rename,
                 dplyr::desc, dplyr::first, dplyr::recode,
                 base::intersect, base::union, base::setdiff, .quiet = TRUE)
```

## files

```{r}
fgsea_mimics    <- read.csv("~/Documents/gutmicrobiome_pharmacology/fgsea_top_mimics_regorafenib_metabolites-4-2-2026.csv")
fgsea_opposites <- read.csv("~/Documents/gutmicrobiome_pharmacology/fgsea_top_opposites_regorafenib_metabolites-4-2-2026.csv")
```

## helpers 

```{r}
strip_kegg <- function(p) gsub(" - Homo sapiens \\(human\\)", "", p)
```

## 1. combine the two result sets into one long table

```{r}
fg <- bind_rows(
  fgsea_mimics    %>% mutate(group = "Mimics"),
  fgsea_opposites %>% mutate(group = "Opposites")
) %>%
  mutate(pathway = strip_kegg(pathway))
```

## 2. significance filter

```{r}
padj_cut <- 0.05          # tighten to 0.01 if you still have too many rows
fg_sig <- fg %>% filter(padj < padj_cut)
```

## 3. collapse redundant immune / infection terms

```{r}
## KEGG carries dozens of individual infection & autoimmune "disease" pathways
## that all ride the same cytokine / NF-kB backbone. We drop the disease-
## specific ones and keep the *mechanistic* signalling pathways, so the immune
## theme is represented by ~a handful of terms instead of 30.
drop_redundant <- paste(
  "infection", "Hepatitis", "Measles", "COVID", "Coronavirus", "Influenza",
  "Tuberculosis", "Leishmaniasis", "Toxoplasmosis", "Salmonella", "papillomavirus",
  "Epstein-Barr", "herpesvirus", "Legionellosis", "Prion", "leukemia virus",
  "Chagas", "Amoebiasis", "Malaria", "Amyotrophic", "Pertussis", "Yersinia",
  "Staphylococcus", "diabetes", "lupus", "graft", "asthma", "allograft",
  "Rheumatoid", "Inflammatory bowel", "cardiomyopathy", "Alcoholism", "addiction",
  sep = "|")
fg_sig <- fg_sig %>%
  filter(!str_detect(pathway, regex(drop_redundant, ignore_case = TRUE)))
```

## 4. classify each pathway into a theme

```{r}
theme_of <- function(p) {
  p <- tolower(p)
  metabolic <- str_detect(p, paste(
    "oxidative phosphorylation", "citrate cycle", "tca", "fatty acid", "pyruvate",
    "glycolysis", "gluconeogenesis", "carbon metabolism", "propanoate", "butanoate",
    "amino acid", "alanine", "cysteine", "glycine", "valine", "arginine", "peroxisome",
    "metabolism", "biosynthesis", "glutathione", sep = "|"))
  immune <- str_detect(p, paste(
    "tnf", "il-17", "nf-kappa", "nod-like", "toll-like", "rig-i", "cytokine",
    "chemokine", "th17", "th1 and th2", "t cell", "b cell", "complement",
    "antigen", "interferon", "inflammat", sep = "|"))
  if (metabolic)      "Metabolic / mitochondrial"
  else if (immune)    "Immune / inflammatory"
  else                "Other"
}
```

## 5. curate down to ~15-20 pathways

```{r}
## how many rows to keep per theme
target <- c("Metabolic / mitochondrial" = 7,
            "Immune / inflammatory"      = 7,
            "Other"                      = 4)

## pathways you always want on the poster, no matter the ranking.
## (edit these to match your exact cleaned KEGG labels)
must_keep <- c(
  "Oxidative phosphorylation", "Citrate cycle (TCA cycle)",
  "TNF signaling pathway", "IL-17 signaling pathway",
  "NF-kappa B signaling pathway", "Pathways in cancer")

## rank pathways within each theme by the strongest effect they show anywhere,
## breaking ties by how many metabolites they hit (breadth)
pathway_rank <- fg_sig %>%
  mutate(theme = map_chr(pathway, theme_of)) %>%
  group_by(theme, pathway) %>%
  summarise(strength = max(abs(NES)), n_hits = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(theme, desc(strength), desc(n_hits)) %>%
  group_by(theme) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(rank <= target[theme])

final_paths <- union(pathway_rank$pathway,
                     intersect(must_keep, fg_sig$pathway))
```

## 6. build ONE combined matrix (rows = pathways, cols = metabolites)

```{r}
mat_df <- fg_sig %>% filter(pathway %in% final_paths)

## metabolite -> Mimic/Opposite lookup for the column split
col_group <- mat_df %>%
  dplyr::distinct(metabolite, group) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(metabolite, .keep_all = TRUE)

wide <- mat_df %>%
  dplyr::select(pathway, metabolite, NES) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = metabolite, values_from = NES, values_fill = 0)

mat <- wide %>% column_to_rownames("pathway") %>% as.matrix()

## row + column grouping factors
row_theme <- map_chr(rownames(mat), theme_of)
row_theme <- factor(
  dplyr::recode(row_theme,
    "Metabolic / mitochondrial" = "Metabolic",
    "Immune / inflammatory"     = "Immune"),
  levels = c("Metabolic", "Immune", "Other"))

rename_paths <- c(
  "Viral protein interaction with cytokine and cytokine receptor" =
    "Viral protein\u2013cytokine interaction",
  "Cytokine-cytokine receptor interaction" = "Cytokine\u2013cytokine receptor",
  "Valine, leucine and isoleucine degradation" = "BCAA (Val/Leu/Ile) degradation",
  "Complement and coagulation cascades" = "Complement & coagulation",
  "Proximal tubule bicarbonate reclamation" = "Proximal tubule bicarbonate",
  "Drug metabolism - cytochrome P450" = "Drug metabolism (CYP450)")
disp_rows <- recode(rownames(mat), !!!rename_paths)

col_split <- setNames(col_group$group, col_group$metabolite)[colnames(mat)]
col_split <- factor(col_split, levels = c("Mimics", "Opposites"))

## shorter column labels: chemical name only, keep the ID only where a name
## would otherwise be duplicated (e.g. inosine appears twice)
short <- sub("\\s*\\(.*$", "", colnames(mat))
dup <- short %in% short[duplicated(short)]
short[dup] <- colnames(mat)[dup]
```

## 7. colourblind-safe brand palette

```{r}
## navy (your section-header blue) = suppressed,  green (your bullets) = activated.
## Works for the common red-green deficiencies because the two poles differ
## strongly in *lightness* (dark navy vs. mid green), not just hue.
lim <- max(abs(mat), na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-lim, 0, lim),
                      c("#2166AC", "#FFFFFF", "#D55E00"))
## alt options — swap the 3 hex codes above:
##   blue -> green (brighter) : c("#2166AC", "#F7F7F7", "#4CAF50")
##   purple -> green (ColorBrewer PRGn, very CB-safe): c("#762A83","#F7F7F7","#1B7837")
##   keep current blue -> orange (most CB-safe of all): c("#2166AC","#FFFFFF","#D55E00")

## write the NES value in each non-empty cell; white text on the dark/saturated
## cells, black elsewhere. Set label_min higher (e.g. 1.5) to label only the
## strong cells, or set show_values <- FALSE to turn numbers off entirely.
show_values <- TRUE
label_min   <- 1.5        # only label cells with |NES| > label_min
val_fontsize <- 8     # 5.5-6 prints fine on A0; bump up if you subset columns
 
nes_cell_fun <- function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
  v <- mat[i, j]
  if (show_values && !is.na(v) && v != 0 && abs(v) > label_min) {
    grid.text(sprintf("%.1f", v), x, y,
              gp = gpar(fontsize = val_fontsize,
                        col = if (abs(v) > lim * 0.55) "white" else "black"))
  }
}
```

## 8. draw

```{r}
ht <- Heatmap(
  mat,
  name  = "NES",
  col   = col_fun,
  ## --- the Mimics | Opposites split with headers ---
  column_split          = col_split,
  cluster_column_slices = FALSE,   # keep Mimics left, Opposites right
  row_split             = row_theme,
  cluster_row_slices    = FALSE,   # keep themes in a fixed order
  ## --- clustering within each block ---
  cluster_rows    = TRUE,  show_row_dend    = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,  show_column_dend = FALSE,
  ## --- labels / cosmetics ---
  row_labels = disp_rows,
  column_labels   = short,
  row_names_side  = "left",
  row_title_side = "right",
  row_names_gp    = gpar(fontsize = 13),
  row_names_max_width = max_text_width(disp_rows, gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13),
  column_names_rot = 45,
  row_title_gp    = gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold"),
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold"),
  border          = TRUE,
  rect_gp         = gpar(col = "grey80", lwd = 0.5),
  right_annotation = rowAnnotation(
    spacer = anno_empty(border = FALSE, width = unit(5, "mm"))),
  cell_fun = nes_cell_fun,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title  = "NES",
    at     = c(-lim, 0, lim),
    labels = c("Suppressed", "0", "Activated"))
)
```
